effects.label: DEF Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Defense stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Skill SPD Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Skill Speed stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Stun
effects.description: The recipient cannot move or attack, and Passive Skills are disabled.Active Skill cooldowns continue to count down as normal.The recipient will continue to take 100% damage from incoming attacks.

bio: Battarok didn't become a mighty Invoker by doing great deeds. He did it by collecting mushrooms. Well, and smashing a cabal of necromancer ghosts with a magic pillar. He hasn’t really stopped the ghost-smashing, and now that stone pillar has a whole lot of ghosts in it. It suits Battarok just fine.
